summary: Agent tools recover after page restore or browser-context replacement, with a draft-preserving manual refresh and distinct expired-registration diagnostics.
warning: Refresh agent tools preserves the live draft. Reloading still requires saving unsaved work first. External integrations must rediscover the current tab's tools; their original reported stale-session cause is not established. Installed packages and saved revisions are unchanged.

checklist.schema: No project, UPID, revision, package or post schema changes. Expired native registrations now return TOOL_REGISTRATION_STALE; data-version mismatches retain STALE_STATE.
checklist.events: No execution events change. Registration lifecycle follows page hide/show, context replacement and manual retry. The initial non-restored pageshow preserves live registrations and active startup calls. Active command cancellation and durable late-commit receipts remain separate.
checklist.capabilities: No machine/post capability changes. Manual registration refresh refuses to interrupt active agent calls.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No execution, controller generation, motion audit or output formatting changes.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No storage migration or installed package/revision writes. Registration refresh does not reload or discard drafts.
checklist.verification: 19 registration/activity tests pass, including context replacement, late context availability, resume, disposed handles, pending StrictMode acknowledgements, live callbacks, manual refresh during a mutation and an active startup mutation surviving initial pageshow. The startup regression failed before the lifecycle fix. Chromium journey preserves dirty geometry through settings navigation and simulated page restore, distinguishes stale registration/data versions, saves and reopens. Native TypeScript, full production build, lint and UI checks pass. Tests do not establish the cause of an external integration cache failure or physical machine verification. CI unit shards explicitly use two workers after repeated five-second deadlines in the same existing editor test under the default worker count. The exact-head editor suite passes, and the complete combined application passes 5949 tests with two workers. Assertions and deadlines are unchanged.

publicNotes.summary: Recover agent tools without reloading your draft.
changes: Agent tools re-register after page restore or a changed browser context.
Refresh agent tools in notifications, and distinguish an expired registration from stale project data.
publicNotes.compatibility: Existing projects, installed posts, saved revisions and controller output are unchanged. Expired tool handles return a specific registration diagnostic.
publicNotes.action: After resuming, rediscover the current tab's tools. If needed, use Refresh agent tools in notifications and rediscover again. Save before any full page reload.
